Subject: Re: Draft terms for Private deployment — question on audit window

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the proposal and the call earlier. Procurement reviewed the draft and has two asks that they say are non‑standard for them but necessary: 

1) Audit window limit — they want a 30‑day notice window (we currently have 7 days in your standard amendment).
2) VPC control carveout — they want to restrict any remote access to the private deployment to specific CIDR ranges and for Redwood to sign an attestation on access procedures.

Can Redwood confirm whether you can accept a 30‑day audit notice and a tighter VPC access carveout? This affects timeline for our internal approvals.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — we are targeting a Dec 1 go‑live.

Best,
Carla

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Exec clearance request — BlueHorizon 30d audit notice + VPC carveout

Team — forwarding Carla's ask and Dylan's note. TL;DR: customer requires 30‑day audit notice (vs our standard 7) and wants CIDR‑locked remote access + signed access attestation.

Proposed path:
- Pricing: we can offer a 7% one‑time onboarding credit if legal approves the carveouts (covers the incremental risk).
- Audit window: we can accept a 30‑day notice but request the scope limited to on‑site or request‑based evidence only (no continuous live access). Put a hard cap on number of audits per 12 months (e.g., 2).
- VPC carveout: we agree to list allowed CIDR ranges in the SOW and supply a quarterly access attestation. We will not permit HSM/KMS key export; keys remain customer‑managed.

Need exec/legal signoff on: 1) accept 30‑day notice with max 2 audits/year, 2) one‑time 7% credit, 3) CIDR + attestation approach (SOW level).

Laura — can you confirm whether Legal is willing to accept the audit cap language? If so I recommend we escalate to VP Revenue for final approval (this is a material non‑standard).

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Deal Desk

Rishi/Dylan/Marissa — reviewed. Legal is generally wary of broad audit windows but okay to accept 30‑day notice under the following constraints (we need to ensure the contract language captures these):

1) Audit frequency capped at 2 per rolling 12 months; any additional requests subject to Redwood's prior written consent.
2) Audit scope limited to discrete evidence (logs, configuration snapshots, process documentation). No remote live sessions that allow interactive shell or admin access.
3) Any personnel access requests require separate NDA and escorted on‑site policy.

If we tighten the language as above and record the CIDR ranges in the SOW with the attestation clause, Legal will approve. Approve recommended 7% onboarding credit as a commercial concession.

I will prepare redline language and route to VP Revenue (Tessa) for final executive approval this afternoon. Once we have the VP signoff I recommend Dylan send the amended contract + Docusign link to Carla.

Laura Bennett
VP Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
